eyebrow: OneLake: the fact behind the trap
code:
Every Lakehouse + every Warehouse in a tenant
  -> same underlying OneLake account
  -> stored as Delta/Parquet, automatically

This is WHY Shortcuts (L.7) and Direct Lake Mode (L.12) work at all.
caption: A Warehouse's data is also OneLake data underneath — a favorite exam gotcha.
